test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Instruction: Choose the inference that are clearly supported by the statement.

Statement: All successful candidates for the astronaut training program possess a doctoral degree in a STEM field, and a perfect physical fitness record is also required.

Inferences:

Inference I: A candidate with a doctoral degree in a STEM field who also has a perfect physical fitness record will be selected for the astronaut training program.

Inference II: Achieving a perfect physical fitness record is not sufficient on its own for selection into the astronaut training program.

options.text: Both Inferences I and II follow
Neither Inference I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statement:

All successful candidates possess a doctoral degree in a STEM field.

A perfect physical fitness record is also required.

Inferences:

I. A candidate with a doctoral degree in a STEM field and perfect physical fitness will be selected –

False (These are necessary conditions, not sufficient. Selection is not guaranteed).

II. Perfect physical fitness alone is not sufficient –

**True** (Because a doctoral degree is also required).

So, only Inference II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
